Fixtures of the pdf-native tier (scripts/pdf-native.lean) and of
Tests/PdfNative.lean: invented figures, each made by a tool the figure
importer meets in practice. Content, text and design are invented; the
only faces are the repository's shipped ones (testdata/corpus/fonts, with
their licences).

cairo-chart.pdf
  rsvg-convert 2.63.2 (cairo 1.18.4, pango 1.58.2, fontconfig 2.18.3) on
  cairo-chart.svg, beside it, with fontconfig confined to the shipped faces
  (a fonts.conf whose one <dir> is testdata/corpus/fonts):
    FONTCONFIG_FILE=<that fonts.conf> rsvg-convert --format=pdf -o cairo-chart.pdf cairo-chart.svg
  TrueType text (Open Sans), a gradient under an opacity (cairo's soft
  mask), a clip, dashes, an opacity group.

lualatex-shade.pdf
  LuaHBTeX 1.24.0 (TeX Live 2026) on lualatex-shade.tex, beside it: the
  standalone the engine wraps the boundary picture of
  testdata/corpus/diagram-boundary.tex in, as the driver hands it to
  lualatex. A pgf axial shading.

lualatex-text.pdf
  LuaHBTeX 1.24.0 (TeX Live 2026) on lualatex-text.tex, beside it, with the
  shipped Source Serif Pro and Fira Math copied into ./fonts:
    lualatex -interaction=batchmode -halt-on-error lualatex-text.tex
  CID-keyed CFF text and math.

lualatex-strokedtext.pdf
  LuaHBTeX 1.24.0 (TeX Live 2026) on lualatex-strokedtext.tex, beside it,
  with the shipped Fira Sans copied into ./fonts:
    lualatex -interaction=batchmode -halt-on-error lualatex-strokedtext.tex
  CID-keyed CFF text painted with a stroke: fontspec's FakeBold (text
  rendering mode 2) and a word in outline mode (1) set by a PDF literal.

leantex-strokes.pdf
  The engine's own writer: leantex testdata/corpus/diagram-strokes.tex,
  on the branch that added this file. OpenType CFF text and TikZ ink.

matplotlib-dialect.pdf
  Written by hand in matplotlib's dialect: scripts/pdf-native.lean
  --fixtures writes it from `PdfNative.matplotlibDialect`, and the tier's
  selftest holds the committed bytes to it.

print-dialect.pdf
  Written by hand in a print workflow's CMYK dialect: scripts/pdf-native.lean
  --fixtures writes it from `PdfNative.printDialect`, and the tier's
  selftest holds the committed bytes to it.

geometry-dialect.pdf
  Written by hand over PDF's own geometry rules: scripts/pdf-native.lean
  --fixtures writes it from `PdfNative.geometryDialect`, and the tier's
  selftest holds the committed bytes to it.

text-dialect.pdf
  Written by hand over the text state's positioning, in a Type 3 font:
  scripts/pdf-native.lean --fixtures writes it from `PdfNative.textDialect`,
  and the tier's selftest holds the committed bytes to it.

SHA256SUMS pins every PDF above; sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS checks them from
this directory.
